This *exactly* describes what RT-2 (2023) and OpenVLA (2024) implement nine years later. Predates RT-2 by 9 years; predates Open X-Embodiment by 9 years. Modern VLA / foundation-model-policy claims face a 2014 fictional disclosure that names the specific training-data source and the specific deployment substrate (humanoid embodiment). Plausibly the strongest single fictional 102 anticipation in the corpus for VLA IP.
